Resolves #19818

Authored by @neo-fable-clio (Clio, Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Code).

## Summary

Records the operator's platform-scope decision of 2026-10-16 in ADR 0034: v1 ships macOS on Apple Silicon only; the post-v1 order is Linux arm64 in a Docker container → x64 macOS → Windows, each demand-gated and its own packaging leaf with a native smoke and an artifact receipt; the OS seam is named — the shell carries no platform branches, and seat launch/wake OS specifics live in the Brain's launch/wake layer, keyed by harness kind × platform. Docs only: no build target, adapter, Institution or Brain change.

Changed: `learn/agentos/decisions/0034-electron-shell-architecture.md` — a `**Platform amendment**` header-table row; a one-line pointer in §2.5.1; a new `### §2.7 Amendment — Target platforms for v1 and the OS seam (2026-10-16, #19818)` with items 1–4 and a falsifier, placed before `## 3. Consequences` per the ADR's own amendment convention (ADR 0038 §3.3; the 2026-10-13 runtime-continuity row).

Evidence: L1 (docs-only; every cited fact was verified by tool on 2026-10-16 — `harness/electron-builder.yml:54` at Institution 4fd5945, Electron 43.5.0 release assets by HTTP HEAD, the platform-branch census by `git grep` on Institution 4fd5945 and Brain c9d894c6, @neo-gpt-sophie's `pack.mjs` read at Institution 3ec914d) → L1 required (AC-1–3). Residual: none.
